name: Changji-Guquan ±1,100 kV UHVDC link, China (SGCC)
description: ±1,100 kV, 12 GW, about 3,300 km from Xinjiang to Anhui; world's highest-voltage DC transmission; full-voltage operation January 2019

sources.note: POWER Magazine (ABB press release): world's first 1,100 kV UHVDC link, orders over USD 300 m; read 2026-10-28
